calibration_sources: ACORN (SIGMOD 2024): Performant and Predicate-Agnostic Search Over Vector Embeddings and Structured Data
Filtered-DiskANN (Microsoft Research): Filtered Vector Search with Stitched Vamana Graphs
Roaring Bitmaps + Zanzibar ReBAC Group-Expansion Caching & Merkle-Tree Chunk Diffing for CDC RAG

tiers.name: Tier 1: Nightly Full Corpus Re-Indexing + Coarse Index-Per-Department Split (24h Stale ACL Exposure)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 每晚全量重算建库 + 按部门粗粒度拆库 (24小时权限撤销延迟泄露 + 95% 重复 Embedding 浪费)
tiers.mechanism: Re-embeds all 50M chunks nightly; revoking a user's SharePoint access leaves vectors searchable for up to 24 hours

tiers.name: Tier 2: Unfiltered Top-K Vector Search + Post-Filtering ACL Check (Zero-Result Starvation at 1.5% Selectivity)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 先跑全局 Top-100 向量检索再做后置权限过滤 (Post-Filtering：1.5% 权限下召回率暴跌至 24.6%)
tiers.mechanism: Fetches global Top-100 nearest chunks first, then drops chunks the user cannot access; if user owns 1.5% of corpus, 98.5% are dropped!

tiers.name: Tier 3: Naive HNSW In-Traversal Pre-Filter without 2-Hop Expansion (Graph Disconnection / Bridge Node Starvation)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 传统 HNSW 遍历中硬跳过无权限节点 (破坏小世界图连通性：桥梁节点被切导致召回卡在 68.4%)
tiers.mechanism: Evaluates ACL bitmap during standard HNSW greedy walk; skipping unauthorized hub nodes disconnects the graph search path

tiers.name: Tier 4: CDC Merkle-Chunk Diff + ACORN / Filtered-DiskANN 2-Hop Predicate Traversal + Roaring Bitmap ACL & Instant Tombstone
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: CDC 块级 Merkle 哈希增量同步 + ACORN/Filtered-DiskANN 谓词感知图导航 + Roaring 位图权限秒级吊销
tiers.mechanism: Embeds only changed paragraph hashes (1.2% daily); decouples ACL metadata into in-memory Roaring Bitmaps with 2-hop predicate-aware graph traversal

selectivity_perturbation.insight: When user can read half the corpus, even Post-Filter finds enough hits in Top-100
Post-Filter starts returning <10 valid chunks Whenever another department has denser cluster matches
Post-Filter returns only 1~2 chunks out of Top-100; Naive HNSW breaks on hub nodes; Tier 4 ACORN holds 96.4%
Tier 4 adaptive selectivity router switches to exact SIMD gather over Roaring Bitmap IDs (50k vectors in 1.8ms!)
